primary_outcome: the statements printed by /app/tools/tdbenefit_run.py give every claim's average weekly wage, weekly rate, waiting, retroactive and paid days, total-disability amount, partial weeks and amount and total owed as manual TD-7 gives them

obligations.contribution: a week's pay (a wage line of 2,000 cents or more) counts toward the payroll week it pays for; a smaller line keeps counting toward its payday's week (silent, kept)

authority.anchor: A week's pay counts toward the payroll week whose work it pays

separability.rationale: decides which pay makes the base-period wages, hence the AWW, rate and every amount

obligations.discriminating_instance: weekly wage lines on every base-period payday and the paydays just outside it; separately, corrections of 1 to 1,999 cents on the payday in the week of injury and in the first base week
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: count every line toward its payday's week (shipped); shift every line a week, corrections included (minimal natural fix of 3.1)

obligations.contribution: the average weekly wage is the base-period wages divided by thirteen

authority.anchor: The average weekly wage is the base-period wages divided by thirteen

separability.rationale: the AWW sets the rate, the partial wage loss and every amount

obligations.discriminating_instance: workers paid for 0, 1, 9, 12 and 13 base weeks
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: divide by the base weeks some line counts toward (shipped)

obligations.contribution: two thirds of the AWW, within the maximum and minimum of the row in force on the date of injury; an AWW below that minimum is the rate

authority.anchor: The weekly rate is two thirds of the average weekly wage

separability.rationale: the rate multiplies every paid day and caps every partial benefit

obligations.discriminating_instance: rates far from the caps; injuries before, on and after a row's effective date with the maximum or minimum binding; AWWs one cent below and at the minimum
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: 60 per cent (shipped); the table's newest row (shipped); lifting a low wage to the minimum (shipped)

obligations.contribution: disability days include both ends; the first three are the waiting period, paid back from fourteen days; the amount is rate x paid days / 7 rounded to the cent

authority.anchor: The total-disability amount is the weekly rate times the paid days

separability.rationale: paid days times the rate make the total owed

obligations.discriminating_instance: one-day periods and claims of twelve periods; claims of 1, 2, 3, 13 and 14 disability days; amounts whose seventh leaves a remainder of four to six
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: exclusive day count, seven waiting days, truncated amount (shipped)

obligations.contribution: a week of partial disability (1,000 cents earned or more) pays two thirds of its wage loss, no more than the weekly rate; any other week of the partial earnings keeps today's share (silent, kept)

authority.anchor: A week of partial disability pays two thirds of its wage loss

separability.rationale: the partial amount adds to the total owed

obligations.discriminating_instance: partial weeks earning 1,000 cents, more, the AWW and above it, with the rate cap binding; separately, weeks earning 0 to 999 cents
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: 60 per cent everywhere (shipped); two thirds for every week once the shared fraction is fixed (minimal natural fix of 3.4/5.1); nothing for a week below 1,000 cents (exclusion reading)
